blind.description: A small arched stone footbridge composed of five wide flat stone slabs forming the walking deck, flanked on both sides by low raised stone curbing blocks. The masonry features stylized, hand-chiseled stone textures with soft bevels and subtle shading. The structure forms a gentle arch supported at both ends with an open underpass beneath the center.
blind.from_above: A long rectangular strip consisting of five broad transverse rectangular stone paving slabs flanked on the left and right edges by a sequence of small rectangular border stones.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the figure at the peak of the arch (roughly 1.8 ft tall), about half the figure's height in width (roughly 3 ft wide), and more than twice the figure's height in length (roughly 13 ft long).
